title: Operational logs and vulnerability identifiers
reason: Phase3 proposal only. Counterbalances demo bias with common real operational schemas and high identifier quality. Two related user journeys share service scope, but are not counted as a fabricated public-data connected component. SPDX rights remain blocked and excluded. NVD reuse/rate policy unresolved blocks NVD publication and complete two-public-source vulnerability journey. CISA CC0 covers catalogue, not linked content/logos. IANA protocol-specific CC0 excludes linked RFC texts. Scalar/range/reserved projection and full media type completeness remain unresolved. KEV absence does not mean safe; dueDate is not a user deadline; names never identify affected products.
practical_value: 73.4/100 proposal value; readiness gated independently. I connect service/event logs with port+transport, IP protocol, HTTP status or exact media tokens and a vulnerability inventory with CVE IDs; inspect source namespaces; request independent bounded enrichments linked through my declared service key.
showcase_value: 3/5, excluded from practical score; What do these transport/port and HTTP values mean, including unassigned or ranged entries?
